## loading data and functions

```{r}
load(file='/home/projects/22140/exam_data/exam_functions.Rdata')
isoform_count1 <- loadIsoformCountMatrix("GSE135188")
isoform_count2 <- loadIsoformCountMatrix("GSE130967,GSE133924,GSE154136")
gene_count1 <- extractGeneCountMatrixFromIsoCounts(isoform_count1)
gene_count2 <- extractGeneCountMatrixFromIsoCounts(isoform_count2)
```

```{r}
isoInfo <- read_rds(
  paste0(
    '/home/projects/22140/exam_data/',
    'Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.107.chr_patch_hapl_scaff_tx_info.Rds'
  )
)
```

#### create files

```{r}
saveRDS(isoform_count1, file = "Data/raw/data_in_vitro_iso.rds")
saveRDS(isoform_count2, file = "Data/raw/data_in_vivo_iso.rds")
saveRDS(gene_count1, file = "Data/raw/data_in_vitro_gene.rds")
saveRDS(gene_count2, file = "Data/raw/data_in_vivo_gene.rds")
```

#### metadata

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("GEOquery", quietly = TRUE)) {
  BiocManager::install("GEOquery")
}
library(GEOquery)
```

```{r}
in_vitro_1 <- getGEO("GSE135188", GSEMatrix = TRUE)
in_vitro_1_pd <- pData(in_vitro_1[[1]]) 
in_vivo_1 <- getGEO("GSE130967", GSEMatrix = TRUE)
in_vivo_1_pd <- pData(in_vivo_1[[1]]) 
```

#### building metadata

```{r}
saveRDS(in_vitro_1_pd, file = "Data/raw/in_vitro_pd1.rds")
saveRDS(in_vivo_1_pd, file = "Data/raw/in_vivo_pd1.rds")
metadata_in_vitro_1 <- data.frame(
  donor     = factor(in_vitro_1_pd$`donor:ch1`),
  treatment = factor(in_vitro_1_pd$`treatment:ch1`, levels = c("air", "CS")),
  disease   = factor(in_vitro_1_pd$`disease state:ch1`, levels = c("healthy", "COPD")),
  sex       = factor(in_vitro_1_pd$`Sex:ch1`),
  age       = as.numeric(in_vitro_1_pd$`age:ch1`),
  ethnicity = factor(in_vitro_1_pd$`ethnicity:ch1`),
  row.names = rownames(in_vitro_1_pd)
)
metadata_in_vivo_1 <- data.frame(
  smoking   = factor(in_vivo_1_pd$`phenotype:ch1`, levels = c("nonsmoker", "smoker")),
  sex       = factor(in_vivo_1_pd$`gender:ch1`),
  age       = as.numeric(in_vivo_1_pd$`age:ch1`),
  ethnicity = factor(in_vivo_1_pd$`ethnicity:ch1`),
  row.names = rownames(in_vivo_1_pd)
)
```

```{r}
all(colnames(gene_count1) == rownames(metadata_in_vitro_1))
all(colnames(gene_count2) == rownames(metadata_in_vivo_1))
setdiff(rownames(metadata_in_vivo_1), colnames(gene_count2))   # campioni in pd2 ma non in data2
setdiff(colnames(gene_count2), rownames(metadata_in_vivo_1))   # campioni in data2 ma non in pd2
metadata_in_vivo_1 <- metadata_in_vivo_1[colnames(gene_count2), ]
all(colnames(gene_count2) == rownames(metadata_in_vivo_1))
```

```{r}
saveRDS(metadata_in_vitro_1, file = "Data/raw/metadata_in_vitro.rds")
saveRDS(metadata_in_vivo_1, file = "Data/raw/metadata_in_vivo.rds")
```
